subject: Venturi Health — DPA / SCCs: transfer addendum clarity and signoff plan
messages:
From: Marta López <marta.lopez@venturihealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@venturihealth.com
Date: 2026-11-02T14:02:00Z
Subject: DPA / SCCs — clarification on transfer addendum and roles

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, our legal team reviewed Redwood's proposed DPA and flagged a couple of items we need clarity on before we can sign:

1) Processor/Controller role: your DPA currently lists a split that would treat some analytics outputs as controller-determined — our counsel wants explicit language confirming Venturi remains controller for customer data and Redwood processes only on instruction, with an exhibit referencing the telemetry and aggregated metrics carve-out.

2) SCCs and transfer addendum: we need confirmation on whether Redwood will adopt the latest EU Commission SCCs by reference and whether the transfer addendum will be issued as a separate addendum or embedded in the DPA. We prefer a standalone transfer addendum to avoid redlining the MSA.

3) Subprocessor notice: sample execution timelines for subprocessors and a short list of EU-hosted subprocessors would help our procurement team evaluate risk.

I've attached a redline (Venturi_DPA_Redline_v1.docx) with inline comments. Can you confirm Redwood's position on items 1–3 and propose a short signoff plan so our legal ops can close this week?

Best,
Marta López
Head of Legal Operations
Venturi Health

--
Attachment: Venturi_DPA_Redline_v1.docx (docx, 82KB)

From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta López <marta.lopez@venturihealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-02T16:15:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs — clarification on transfer addendum and roles

Hi Marta — thanks for the redline and for outlining the asks. Looping in Ben (contracts) and Laura (privacy) so we can align on language and timing. Quick responses below and a proposed signoff plan: 

1) Controller/Processor: We agree to a clear carve that Venturi is controller of customer content and personal data; Redwood will be listed as processor acting on documented instructions. We'll add explicit language to the DPA and an exhibit noting aggregated telemetry excluded from controller responsibilities. Laura is drafting the exhibit now.

2) SCCs / transfer addendum: Redwood's preference is to reference the latest EU SCCs and include a separate Transfer Addendum document (keeps MSA cleaner). We'll prepare the standalone Transfer Addendum in parallel and send you both the DPA redline and the stand‑alone Transfer Addendum for review.

3) Subprocessors: We'll provide a current subprocessor list and an estimated notice cadence (standard: 30 days for new subprocessors, immediate notice for changes affecting region). For EU-hosted subprocessors we can provide region and country. Ben, can you pull the current list and add to the response packet?

Proposed signoff plan (timeline):
- Today: Redwood sends consolidated redline + Transfer Addendum draft + subprocessor list (attachments below).
- Tue 11/03: Venturi legal provides counter-markups or quick approvals on the DPA/Transfer Addendum.
- Wed 11/04: Final minor touchups; DocuSign prepped.
- Fri 11/06: Target signature and order form execution.

If that works, we'll push the docs shortly.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Response_Notes.pdf, SCCs_Annex_A_draft.txt

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs — consolidated materials ready

Monica / Laura — I've pulled the subprocessor inventory and added EU-hosting flags. Summary:

- Subprocessor list attached (internal). EU-hosted: Atlas EU, StorageCo-IE, AuditLog EU.
- Proposed short wording for Controller confirmation: "Venturi Health shall be the Controller of Customer Data; Redwood shall act as Processor and shall process Customer Data solely on documented instructions from Venturi except as required by law."
- Transfer Addendum: drafted as a separate 1‑page addendum referencing the current SCC set by default and including a clause for automatic adoption of updated SCCs upon publication unless parties opt out in writing.

I've attached the inventory to this thread (internal attachment). Monica — ready to bundle and send to Venturi. Should I upload the Transfer Addendum draft to Drive and share the DocuSign template?

Ben Carter
Senior Contracts Counsel, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_internal.csv (internal)

From: Marta López <marta.lopez@venturihealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@venturihealth.com
Date: 2026-11-06T09:23:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs — consolidated materials ready

Monica, Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround. Your plan looks good; we've reviewed the controller wording and the Transfer Addendum approach with our external counsel and have only two small asks before signature: 

1) Add a short fallback for data subject requests: a single paragraph in the DPA describing coordination steps (timing and primary points of contact) so operational teams can map workflows.

2) In the Transfer Addendum, can we change the SCC auto-adoption to "automatic notification of updates with 30 days to object" (Venturi to have 30 days to opt-out by written notice) rather than automatic adoption? That meets our compliance governance.

Attached is our redline of your Transfer Addendum (marked). If those two tweaks are acceptable, we'll be ready to DocuSign on Friday. I've included the DocuSign prepared envelope link for your convenience.

Thanks,
Marta
